Under Definition 2 as printed in Carsten Dietzel's *Some problems on L-algebras*, every nonempty meet-semilattice admits a semibrace structure. A meet-semilattice admits both that semibrace structure and the printed L-algebra axioms if and only if it has a greatest element.
